Record notes

Six complete methods for Figma operation, design-partner iteration, source references and visual QA.

Version 0.2.1 includes 6 complete skill procedures. Complete method package; Figma service remains external.

Requirements: Figma account; Host Figma connector or browser tools.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add figma-design-workflow@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 9d932e599c75a2d5fa7e7bafe35207f13389e98c. SHA-256: 0996363ef360f6bea9adf6024b1111f1cb8c612fa406efe098dc5d9555d39180.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
